image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a classic car wheel featuring a chrome wire-spoke rim and a whitewall tire. The wheel is mounted on a light green vehicle body visible in the upper left corner. The tire shows tread details and sits on an asphalt surface.

artifact_observations.location: Wire spokes near the central hub
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some of the inner wire spokes appear slightly fused or lack individual definition compared to the outer spokes, likely due to reflection complexity or minor generation softness, but not structurally impossible.
The line between the black tire and whitewall is slightly wavy in the lower-left quadrant, deviating from a perfect geometric circle, though this could be attributed to tire deformation under weight.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-type (wire wheel) and ensure it falls within the 'car wheel' taxonomy without misclassification as a bicycle wheel or generic circle.
Wire wheels are topologically complex. This expert will verify that each spoke is a continuous line connected to both the hub and the rim, checking for 'floating' segments or fusion errors.
To ensure the wheel sits correctly on the ground plane (asphalt) and that the reflections on the chrome do not create false depth cues or melting into the background.
Chrome reflections are a common failure point in AI images. This expert will assess if the reflections are coherent with the environment or if they contain nonsensical patterns.

focus_areas: Continuity of individual wire spokes (no breaks or fusions)
Geometric circularity of the whitewall/tire boundary
Coherence of chrome reflections on the central spinner
Contact shadow between tire and asphalt
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the wire spokes. In AI-generated wire wheels, spokes often merge into the hub or rim incorrectly. Verify if the 'texture_anomaly' noted by the Router is actually a structural fusion error. Also, check if the whitewall irregularity is a perspective artifact or a generation defect.
